# P26.10 — procurement-portal tenants: BidNet, Bonfire, OpenGov, Socrata (SOURCES.9)

The multi-tenant registry pattern reaches *purchasing* — the strongest
predictive signal in the graph. **17 procurement tenants** enumerated across
four public surfaces (9 BidNet purchasing-group storefronts, 5 per-city Socrata
contract/notice datasets, 2 Bonfire + 1 OpenGov gated portals), and **4
licence-reviewed Socrata cities flipped under GL-GATE-06 and run live** —
`procurement_notice` + verbatim `content_term` claims from captured
RFP/award/contract records.
